description: Office Of the Governor Uva Province. - Appointed 11 officers for Uva Province Provincial Council.
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel changes (appointments to the Board of Library Service of Uva Province) with named individuals and their basic titles/positions. It does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas for these appointments, which would be required for a Hybrid classification. The content focuses solely on who is being appointed to which positions.
